OUR FIVE-STEP METHODOLOGY

From concept drawings.
To living inside them.

A transparent architectural workflow that honors your structural intent from the opening CAD mark to the final interactive walkthrough.

01 — CRAFTING THE THIRD DIMENSION

From draft lines to
spatial presence.

Experience the transformation step by step.
Watch raw conceptual sketches evolve into a tactile, fully furnished architectural environment.

THE COURTYARD RESIDENCE01 / VECTOR DRAFT BLUEPRINT
01 — VECTOR DRAFT

Every great space
begins with a bold line.

Your initial floor layout, captured as clean digital geometry. Core boundary walls, sightlines, and atmospheric courtyard relationships are established from the very first mark.

ORIGINAL VECTOR BLUEPRINT · PURE DIGITAL GEOMETRY
02 — CAD PRECISION

Translating sketches into
millimeter accuracy.

Exterior perimeter, partition walls, window fenestrations, and threshold clearances are digitized with true architectural proportion. Every structural dimension is verified before dimensional modeling begins.

PROPORTIONAL ENVELOPE: 30 M × 12 M · ASSUMED WALL HEIGHT 2.8 M
03 — INTERIOR STAGING

Curating surfaces,
texture and natural light.

Tactile European oak flooring, polished cast stone, linen upholstery, and tailored kitchen millwork are placed with purpose. Every fixture and piece of furniture is scaled to human proportions.

NATURAL OAK · HONED STONE · CURATED LIVING GREENERY
04 — SPATIAL VOLUME

Raising the walls into
living volume.

Planar geometry extrudes into three dimensions: vertical volumes rise to 2.8 meters, bespoke ceiling heights form, and natural sunlight casts gentle ambient shadows across every room.

Parametric 3D architecture: walls extruded to 2.8 m with calibrated window and door lintels.

PARAMETRIC 3D GEOMETRY · COMPILED TO SEAMLESS GLB
05 — INTERACTIVE TOUR

Deliver the experience.
Welcome them home.

The completed spatial scene compiles into an ultra-fast, zero-install web showcase. Send a single link to clients or investors, allowing them to orbit, inspect, and experience room by room on any device.

Interact with the residence: rotate the model, inspect individual rooms, and toggle evening light.

Select specific room viewpoints or orbit smoothly around the entire architectural volume.
